title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Operações - Manutenção
description:

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


MISSÃO DO CARGO

Garantir a excelência técnica, padronização, eficiência econômica e evolução contínua dos processos de manutenção predial e utilidades do portfólio da companhia, atuando como referência corporativa e parceiro estratégico das operações locais, assegurando confiabilidade dos ativos, redução de riscos, Compliance legal e captura de ganhos financeiros.

  • Apoiar mitigação de riscos técnicos críticos;

title: Vision Systems Engineer
description:
Project Description:

- Hands-on technical leader responsible for designing, optimizing, and productizing high-performance computer vision and AI pipelines for consumer devices. This role ensures real-time performance, power efficiency, and production robustness across embedded platforms.


Responsibilities:

- Design and implement advanced computer vision and image processing pipelines optimized for real-time consumer devices.

- Collaborate with ISP, sensor, and tuning teams to optimize image quality for downstream AI and UX performance.

- Develop and deploy ML models for visual recognition, enhancement, tracking, or scene understanding.

- Optimize ML models for edge deployment (quantization, pruning, distillation, hardware-aware tuning).

- Implement performance-critical algorithms in modern C++ for embedded platforms.

- Optimize for latency, power consumption, memory footprint, and thermal constraints.

- Integrate inference engines (TFLite, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, etc.) on target SoCs.

- Work closely with Android/Linux platform teams to integrate camera and AI pipelines.

- Define and track KPIs: FPS, power usage, memory, startup time, and accuracy.

- Profile and optimize performance across CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP.

- Drive debugging of complex system-level issues in production builds.

- Ensure robust unit testing and contribute to automated validation pipelines.

- Mentor engineers and review architecture/design proposals.

- Support product bring-up and mass production readiness.


Mandatory Skills Description:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

- 7-10+ years of experience in computer vision/image processing.

- Proven experience shipping at least one consumer product with embedded vision/AI.

- Strong C++ expertise (C++14/17/20), including performance optimization.

- Strong experience with OpenCV and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX).

- Experience deploying ML models on embedded/edge devices.

- Experience with model optimization (quantization, pruning).

- Strong understanding of 2D/3D geometry and linear algebra.

- Experience working on embedded Linux or Android systems.

- Strong debugging and performance profiling skills.

- Experience optimizing for power and thermal constraints.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- Experience with mobile SoCs (Qualcomm, MediaTek, Exynos, etc.).

- Experience with CUDA / OpenCL / Vulkan / OpenGL ES / SIMD.

- Experience with camera calibration and ISP interaction.

- Experience building for Android Camera HAL or Yocto-based systems.

- Experience with AR, computational photography, or video processing.

- Experience with multi-camera systems.

- Exposure to production validation and manufacturing constraints.


Languages:

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Treasury Analyst
description:
About Credix


Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America.

We originate more than R$700M per year in B2B credit to Brazilian SMEs through CrediPay, our embedded finance platform. We operate in a segment where traditional financial infrastructure is limited, building proprietary credit intelligence and risk frameworks that do not yet exist in this market.

By combining structured capital markets solutions with real-time credit decisioning, we enable marketplaces and suppliers to offer seamless payment terms to their buyers, while we manage risk, pricing, and capital efficiency behind the scenes.

We are not a traditional lender. We are building the risk engine that powers scalable B2B commerce in Brazil.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

As our Treasury Analyst you will be the financial engine behind Credix's growth. You will ensure disciplined cash management, optimal allocation of treasury capital, and robust operational support for the FIDC — making treasury a zero-surprise, high-performance function. Beyond operations, you will play a strategic role in enabling new financial products by providing the close monitoring of disbursements and collateral management that these products demand, while co-owning the definition of Credix's SEC liquidity policy. You will report to the Head of Finance.


Qualifications

  • Treasury & Investment Management: Ability to assess and execute short-to-medium term investments across fixed income instruments, optimising for yield within defined risk limits.
  • Cash Flow Modelling: Strong spreadsheet skills for building and maintaining multi-scenario short-term cash forecasts.
  • FIDC Mechanics: Deep understanding of FIDC capital structure, capital calling processes, bordero flows, and settlement reconciliation.
  • Collateral Management: Familiarity with collateral monitoring frameworks, margin calls, and eligibility criteria for structured credit products.
  • Brazilian Payment Infrastructure: Solid understanding of domestic payment rails (TED, PIX, boleto) and settlement flows in a regulated financial environment.
  • Disbursements Monitoring: Ability to track and analyse disbursement flows, identify bottlenecks, and escalate proactively.
  • Excel / Google Sheets at advanced level;
    SQL is a plus.
  • Precision Under Pressure: Zero tolerance for errors in transfers and reconciliations;
    thrives in a structureddaily ops rhythm.
  • Structured Communication: Clear escalation instincts — you know what to resolve independently and what requires immediate alignment with leadership.
  • Process Builder: Actively documents recurring processes and builds runbooks so that nothing lives only in someone's head.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: Proactively seeks to understand the financial and structural rationale behind each treasury and capital markets flow.
  • Ownership: Treats treasury as a product to be continuously improved, not a task list to be cleared.
  • Strategic Mindset: Sees beyond daily operations to understand how treasury efficiency directly drives business growth.
  • Cross-Functional: Comfortable operating at the intersection of Engineering, Capital Markets, Risk, and GTM.


Responsibilities

description:
Netcracker Shaping the Digital Future

As a proud subsidiary of NEC Corporation, Netcracker is a global software leader driving innovation at scale. We combine an open Agentic AI Platform with AI-Native IT Solutions to help telecommunication providers transform, innovate, and deliver results that matter. Powered by cutting-edge technology—and the passion of our people—we unlock new opportunities, spark innovation, and create better digital experiences for millions worldwide. Join us and be part of a team that is not just keeping up with the digital future—we’re leading it.


About the role

The Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns. Additionally, the analyst will optimize processes, track project health, and assist with forecast, invoicing and payments.


Role & Responsibilities

  • Act as a key contact for interpreting and investigating financial results for assigned projects
  • Prepare, reconcile, analyze, and report project KPIs
  • Review actual and planned resources, flag discrepancies to Project Managers
  • Handle project closeout reconciliations and escalate issues as needed
  • Analyze financial and business data for assigned projects and contracts
  • Coordinate with Project Managers on change orders, project status, resourcing, and budgets
  • Assist in developing regular financial status reports for projects
  • Record monthly revenue for contracts and communicate estimates to clients
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor contracts, acting as the contact point for external/internal resources
  • Attend project meetings to support Project Managers and ensure accurate forecasting
  • Track overall project health, including revenues, gross profit, receivables, and project closeouts
  • Ensure that operational procedures are being followed by Project Teams
  • Identify and work with team leads to resolve and/or escalate violations as needed
  • Validate reports obtained from projects and ensure that the reports are provided on time
  • Work with project team leads and program directors on operational support needs, set up and lead project meetings
  • Assist with Resource plan baselines
  • Review and manage exceptions and escalate to stakeholders as needed
  • Process and distribute reports, defining tool requirements
  • Analyze and monitor dashboard reports on every project created monthly
  • Identify planned projects monthly
  • Identify projects with Level of Effort (LOE) overage and escalate these to senior management
  • Schedule invoices and assist in their payment
  • Work with management to optimize processes


Required Experience

  • 3 or more years experience working in financial analysis
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently
  • Able to work well with others
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Knowledge of Project Management Standard and Great Plains system.
  • Prior experience in project analysis and ASC 606 revenue recognition strongly preferred
  • Prior experience in portfolio financial management and forecasting strongly preferred
  • Significant past experience in an administrative position with responsibility for audit and processing tasks
  • Ability to follow business rules and procedures while analyzing and identifying errors in processes and data
  • Really good attention to detail
  • Fluent English speaker
  • Availability to work from office in hybrid mode


Education

  • BSC in Accounting/Finance, or related field

title: New Business & Project Manager - D2c Latam
description:
Job Title: New Business & Sales Projects Manager - D2C LATAM | Samsung Electronics


Highlights :

  • Location: São Paulo - SP.
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time
  • Work Modality: On Site


Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !


Job Description

The LATAM D2C Team is responsible for the sales growth of eCommerce DtC Channels (Samsung.Com, B2B2C, B2B and Omni Channel) working in partnership with the 7 subsidiaries in Latin America.

As we expand our operations in the region, we are looking for a D2C New Business & Sales Projects Manager.

Together with Samsung subsidiaries (LATAM), the role will be responsible for the development, sales and overall performance of the main D2C sales programs and new business projects, leading the following pillars/strategic areas:

- D2C Sell-out Platforms Management: Strengthen LATAM D2C exclusive programs (such as: Trade-in, Co-Branded Card, Extended Warranty, Installation Service), enabling the sales growth and targets achievement.

- New Business Projects: Define innovative programs based on sell-out platforms such as subscription models and value-added services and draw the commercial strategies to execute and grow them.

- D2C Partnerships: Responsible for stablishing and managing new partners for LATAM D2C, aiming to create opportunities of customer acquisition, traffic increase and co-investments for sales conversion.

- Sales Operations: Promote eStore capabilities and coordinate key initiatives along with internal platform/product teams or external partners, aiming to achieve D2C main targets.

- CRP: Customer Retention Program ambassador in LATAM D2C, engaging all subsidiary in the company’s strategy and promoting the alignment and projects execution with CS and related stakeholders.

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Define, track, report and engage subs to implement the regional/global Sell-out enablers strategy, and ensure the main KPIs achievement.
  • Define the sell-out programs sales strategy by working with the business areas to implement the promotional and forecast plan.
  • Ensure the sell-out programs’ financial sustainability while balancing an attractive promotional agenda with business profitability.
  • Support in marketing / UX strategies for the sell-out enablers launch and enhancement, ensuring the correct communication and display of programs for brand consumers;
  • Act as a PMO ofregional projects that focus on accelerating D2C performance;
  • Together with Samsung subsidiaries in LATAM, act in the management of partnerships that make up the digital online channel ecosystem.
  • Prospect regional partnerships and co-lead the deployment of those along with the subsidiaries, focusing on the continuous creation of new business and co-investment opportunities.
  • In conjunction with the IT team, manage the D2C sell-out projects roadmap, responding by the business assessment, development, execution, GTM and usability of the tools.
  • Manage the continuous improvement agenda of the D2C programs, focusing on user experience and increasing of conversion.
  • Integration with CS Team and related areas to promote CRP (Customer Retention Program) agenda in D2C LATAM, engaging eStore Business and Commercial teams to implement the regional strategy.
  • Executive report on sell-out programs strategies and business results.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration or other relevant areas.
  • Experience in new business and projects department.
  • Management/operation of e-commerce platforms.
  • Strong skills in communication and project management.
  • Master presentation and report skills, structured by deep data analysis.
  • Ease in dealing with complex database, SQL queries, VBA and Excel program.
  • Advanced English skills, Spanish will be considered a plus.


Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team : Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges : Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future : Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact : Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.


Benefits :

  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Global networking and collaboration



At Samsung, we want you to be yourself! We prioritize fairness and will never request personal information unrelated to the selection process, such as marital status, age, gender, religion, or political opinions.


(For Samsung Electronics Employees Only - Job Requisition Number: R )

title: Sap Mm Consultant
description:

  • Experience with master data governance and process optimization.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with global or distributed teams .
  • Good English skills for conversation, meetings, and written communication .


Nice to Have

  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA MM .

title: Senior Systems Developer | Professional English Mandatory
description:
Senior Systems Developer


If you are looking for a meaningful career where people work and act with passion, rethink the existing, and always strive to find the best solution — you have come to the right place. We develop future technologies to relentlessly make supply chains better.

We are a leader in supply chain software solutions, helping organizations streamline operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency.

As a Senior Systems Developer on our implementation team — primarily focused on international projects, as well as projects in Brazil — you will work daily to solve problems and create customized solutions for our clients.

· Strong teamwork skills, initiative, versatility, and discipline to meet deadlines and goals.

· Availability for domestic and international travel.

· Eligible for CLT employment model.

· Fluent English.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Scrum Master Senior , who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will

  • Act as a facilitator for the agile team, ensuring that Scrum principles and practices are correctly applied, removing impediments, and fostering a collaborative environment of continuous improvement.
  • Support the Product Owner, the development team, and business areas, ensuring that deliveries generate value, quality, and alignment with the organization’s strategic objectives.

  • Experience working with multiple teams or in complex contexts.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proactivity, collaboration, and ability to work in multidisciplinary teams.
  • Facilitation skills, active listening, and conflict resolution capability.
  • Knowledge of software development processes.
  • Organization skills, prioritization mindset, and focus on value.
  • Completed higher education degree in any field, plus a market‑recognized Scrum Master certification (such as PSM I/II, CSM, KSD, KSI, SAFe, or equivalent widely recognized by the market).


Desirable Skills

  • Agile certifications: PSM I/II, CSM, KSD, KSI, SAFe, among others.
  • Experience with flow metrics or predictive metrics.
  • Experience in digital transformation environments.
  • Knowledge of scaling frameworks (SAFe, LeSS, Nexus).

#VemSerMiraeAsset


Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno


Descrição da vaga:


Buscamos um Analista Sênior em Segurança da Informação para atuar como guardião da resiliência tecnológica da empresa. Alguém com visão holística, que consiga equilibrar práticas tradicionais de defesa com estratégias modernas, automatização e governança sólida. Este é um papel estratégico, com autonomia, responsabilidade e forte interface com áreas de TI e negócios.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência sólida em Segurança da Informação (nível sênior).
  • Domínio em gestão de riscos, incidentes e vulnerabilidades.
  • Conhecimento avançado de redes, protocolos, arquitetura e modelos de segurança.
  • Experiência com Azure (Microsoft M365) e AWS em contexto de segurança.
  • Vivência com ferramentas SIEM, EDR/XDR e soluções de proteção de endpoint.
  • Entendimento de LGPD e compliance regulatório aplicável.
  • Experiência com IAM, políticas e controles de acesso.
  • Capacidade de escrever e manter políticas, processos e padrões corporativos.
  • Boa comunicação para se relacionar com tecnologia e negócio sem ruído.


Competências Comportamentais:


  • Proatividade e senso de urgência.
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.
  • Organização e foco em resultados.
  • Capacidade analítica e orientação a solução de problemas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Liderar iniciativas de segurança, garantindo aderência a normas, políticas internas e frameworks de mercado (NIST, CIS, LGPD).


  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, análises de vulnerabilidade e propor planos de mitigação eficazes.

description:

A posição exige acompanhamento contínuo de mudanças regulatórias, suporte na implementação de controles internos e interação com áreas como jurídico, riscos, produtos e tecnologia.


Responsabilidades


  • Monitorar e interpretar regulamentações aplicáveis ao mercado de criptoativos e serviços de ativos virtuais.
  • Apoiar na implementação e manutenção do programa de compliance regulatório da VASP.
  • Contribuir para a adequação às normas de PLD/FT, KYC, KYT e Travel Rule.
  • Elaborar e revisar políticas, procedimentos e controles internos relacionados à conformidade regulatória.
  • Conduzir análises regulatórias para novos produtos, serviços ou funcionalidades envolvendo criptoativos.
  • Apoiar em processos de auditorias internas e externas relacionadas a compliance e requisitos regulatórios.
  • Preparar relatórios e materiais para reguladores, auditorias e comitês internos.
  • Realizar monitoramento de transações e apoiar investigações relacionadas a atividades suspeitas quando necessário.
  • Atuar junto às áreas internas para garantir a implementação adequada de requisitos regulatórios.
  • Acompanhar tendências regulatórias globais no setor de ativos virtuais.
  • Apoiar treinamentos internos sobre compliance, AML e regulamentação de criptoativos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Graduação em Direito, Economia, Administração, Relações Internacionais, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em Compliance, AML, PLD/FT ou Risco Regulatório.
  • Conhecimento do mercado de criptoativos e blockchain.
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com regulamentação financeira ou fintech.
  • Conhecimento de processos de KYC, KYT e monitoramento de transações.
  • Capacidade de análise regulatória e elaboração de políticas e relatórios.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Desejáveis


  • Experiência prévia em exchange, fintech, banco digital ou VASP.
  • Conhecimento de regulamentações internacionais aplicáveis a criptoativos (ex.: FATF, MiCA etc.).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de blockchain analytics.
  • Certificações em compliance ou AML.
  • Experiência com auditorias regulatórias ou interação com reguladores.


Diferenciais

  • Participação em projetos de adequação regulatória em fintechs.
  • Conhecimento de DeFi, stablecoins, custody, tokens e infraestrutura de ativos digitais.

Isso significa que seu foco será:

Aqui, vendas é tratada como processo, disciplina e consistência.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
The world's largest enterprises were built on an assumption about how technology works: wait for it to stabilize, evaluate what it can do, then implement. That sequence made sense when technology moved in waves with long plateaus between them.


AI doesn't have plateaus. It compounds. The models running today will be a fraction of what exists in six months, and every pause gives back what came before.


We built Tela to be the reference for enterprise AI, meaning: embedded teams and a platform that live at the frontier, inside the enterprises that can't afford to stop moving. We call this Adoption in Motion (AIM) : continuous, never a project with an end date. Two years in, we're embedded inside leaders across financial services, energy, telecom, among others.


We're Looking For

A Deployment Strategist to make AIM real inside these partners.

You'll work shoulder to shoulder with C-level executives on the hardest problems inside a large enterprise. The kind of work that moves the economics of the business.

You'll sit where three worlds meet: the frontier of AI, the inside of a large enterprise, and Tela's solution engineers. Your job is to keep the three in sync so motion never stops.

This role didn't exist in the enterprise world before AI started compounding. It exists now because nothing else fits. Vendors leave. Consultancies run projects. Internal teams move in planning cycles. AIM never ends — and a Deployment Strategist is the person who keeps it alive.


Your day-to-day

  • Own a partner relationship end to end: from discovery, through deployment, into continuous adoption.
  • Turn hard business problems into AI-native solutions alongside our solution engineers.
  • Find the highest-leverage opportunities inside a partner's operations and sequence them into a roadmap that compounds.
  • Make trade-offs visible to executives so they can decide fast, with real information.
  • Measure impact in the partner's own language: revenue, cost, speed, risk.
  • Lead internal initiatives at Tela that shape where our platform and playbook go next.


Bonus Points For

  • Experience in strategic consulting or product management, with exposure to problem-solving, structured analysis, and executive-level projects
  • Background in technology-driven projects or a strong interest in AI platforms, workflow automation, and adjacent systems
  • Experience navigating complex organizations, stakeholders, and decision-making processes


You'll Excel Here If You...

description:
Descrição da empresa:

O profissional será responsável pela montagem mecânica, corte, ajuste e preparação de estruturas metálicas e tubulações em aço carbono, inox e plásticos, deixando os conjuntos prontos para soldagem e instalação final.

  • Manter o local de trabalho organizado e zelar pelos equipamentos e ferramentas.

  • Conhecimento básico de alinhamento, nivelamento e montagem de equipamentos;
  • Familiaridade com diferentes tipos de materiais (aço carbono, inox e plásticos);
  • Conhecimento básico de normas de segurança do trabalho (NR’s);

The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data, extract insights, and help solve problems.

develop reports according to analyst-defined specifications

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Senior Business Analyst
Company Overview
Our client is a growing mining company currently transitioning from exploration through project development and into operations, with strong expansion plans beyond this first phase that will position it as a significant gold producer in the Brazilian market. The business is entering a critical phase, combining operational ramp-up with multiple capital projects.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Senior Business / Commercial Analyst to support the organization during its transition into production while enabling future growth through capital expansion projects.

This is a highly visible role reporting directly to the VP of Project Development, with cross-functional exposure across operations, finance, projects, and executive leadership, including interaction with senior stakeholders.

The successful candidate will play a key role in driving business planning, performance analysis, and financial modeling to support strategic and operational decision-making.

Accountabilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Manage the business planning process, including coordination, preparation, and continuous improvement
  • Analyze and report on key business performance metrics across operations, projects, and exploration
  • Prepare and deliver monthly management reports, covering operational, construction, and improvement initiatives
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance the project financial model
  • Support capital allocation processes, including preparation of investment proposals (CAPEX requests)
  • Prepare executive presentations and communications for internal stakeholders and senior leadership
  • Act as a business partner across multiple functions, supporting data-driven decision-making
  • Contribute to the development of processes, governance, and performance management frameworks
  • Identify and drive business improvement initiatives to increase the capital efficiency of the assets
  • Management of 1-2 employees reporting directly to the role



Requirements
The ideal candidate must have:
  • Technical degree in Business Administration / Economics / Engineering + business/analytics specialization + industry exposure.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in business analysis within the mining industry, can be across different mining commodities (e.G., gold, iron ore, base metals, etc.)
  • Strong background supporting both project development and operational phases
  • Advanced proficiency in financial modeling (Excel) and presentation tools (PowerPoint)
  • Experience working in capital-intensive environments with multiple projects (CAPEX)
  • Ability to operate effectively in a cross-functional and fast-evolving environment
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with confidence interacting with senior leadership and Board level
  • Advanced or fluent English is mandatory (daily interaction)

Profile:
  • Mature, hands-on, and highly analytical professional
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect financial insights to operational performance
  • Structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to bring clarity in complex environments
  • Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable working in a dynamic and growing organization
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills

Work Model: This position offers a hybrid work model, allowing flexibility between on-site and remote work:

  • Approximately 50% of the time based on site (operations/projects in Para State)
  • Approximately 50% remote (home office)

This structure enables close connection with operations while maintaining flexibility for analytical and strategic work.

Why join
This is a unique opportunity to join a mining company at a pivotal moment, transitioning into operations while scaling its footprint through strategic expansion projects. The role offers high visibility, direct exposure to leadership, and the chance to shape the company’s performance management and decision-making processes.

The Rewards
The position offers a competitive remuneration package including eligibility to participate in the Company’s Employee Share Option Plan.

Contact us
Please apply directly by submitting your resume, preferably as a Microsoft Word document

title: Assistente De Comércio Exterior
description:
SOBRE NÓS

A ZAWA é uma empresa em crescimento contínuo no setor de importação e e-commerce, com atuação consolidada há mais de oito anos nos principais marketplaces do país. Com sede administrativa em Curitiba/PR e operação logística em Joinville/SC, trabalhamos com processos enxutos e uma estrutura organizacional compacta, composta por equipes de 5 a 10 pessoas. Mantemos o foco na qualidade, na eficiência operacional e na excelência no atendimento ao cliente.

Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis nascem da autorresponsabilidade e da dedicação ao essencial. Nossa cultura, pautada na autonomia, colaboração, organização e praticidade, está refletida nos seguintes princípios:

  • Essencialismo: Priorizamos o que gera valor. Evitamos excesso de processos e mantemos ambientes físicos e digitais organizados e funcionais.
  • Responsabilidade individual: Esperamos que cada colaborador assuma o protagonismo da própria evolução, com consciência e compromisso.
  • Capricho e qualidade: A atenção aos detalhes é fundamental para nosso padrão de excelência. Prezamos entregas bem executadas, com precisão e zelo.
  • Melhoria contínua: Incentivamos a busca ativa por conhecimento. Entendemos que aprender e aprimorar são necessidades constantes.
  • Mentalidade orientada à solução: Além de identificar problemas e desafios, nossos profissionais buscam soluções viáveis, traduzindo ideias em planos de ação.

SOBRE A VAGA

Cargo: Assistente de Comércio Exterior

Tipo de contratação: PJ (híbrido)

Local: Sede administrativa – Rebouças, Curitiba/PR

Remuneração: R$ 3.000,00 - 4.000,00

Benefícios:

  • PDI (Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual)
  • Bonificação trimestral por desempenho: +50% remuneração
  • Bonificação anual por meta da empresa batida: +13º remuneração


ATRIBUIÇÕES

O Assistente de Comércio Exterior será responsável pelo suporte operacional às rotinas de importação, garantindo a organização dos processos, a atualização das informações e o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos. Atuará no acompanhamento das etapas logísticas e documentais, interface com parceiros e apoio às demandas da área, contribuindo para a eficiência e controle das operações. Suas responsabilidades incluirão:


  • Apoiar na abertura, organização e acompanhamento de processos de importação;
  • Apoiar estudo de viabilidade para importação de novos produtos, incluindo classificação fiscal (NCM), análise de tributos, benefícios fiscais e exigências regulatórias (ANVISA, INMETRO, ANATEL, etc);
  • Realizar follow-up com fornecedores internacionais, tradings , agentes de carga, despachantes e áreas internas, garantindo alinhamento das informações;
  • Acompanhar as etapas de transporte internacional, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos produtivos, logísticos e documentais (ETD, ETA, embarque e entrega);
  • Conferir e organizar documentos de importação (Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading, entre outros);
  • Apoiar na conferência de notas fiscais de entrada e processos fiscais relacionados;
  • Auxiliar na cotação de fretes internacionais e serviços logísticos;
  • Solicitar pagamentos internacionais e operações de câmbio, conforme orientação da área;
  • Desenvolver relatórios operacionais e indicadores da área;
  • Atualizar sistemas internos, planilhas e controles com prazos, status e informações das operações;
  • Contribuir para a padronização e melhoria contínua dos processos internos;
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas operacionais e na mitigar riscos relacionados aos processos de importação.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÃO

Competências obrigatórias:

-Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Comércio Exterior, Relações Internacionais, Administração ou áreas correlatas;

- Comunicação escrita: capacidade de conduzir interações contínuas e assíncronas via chat de forma estruturada, objetiva e sequencial, considerando fuso horário e dinâmica cultural de fornecedores internacionais (especialmente asiáticos);

- Excel intermediário/avançado

- Inglês intermediário (leitura e escrita);

- Conhecimento em matemática básica aplicada.


Competências desejadas:

  • Vivência em rotinas operacionais de comércio exterior e processos de importação;
  • Experiência em negociações internacionais;
  • Conhecimento em cálculo de custos de importação (produto, frete, impostos e despesas operacionais).


EXPECTATIVAS

O que buscamos:

  • Perfil analítico, lógico e metódico;
  • Postura voltada para resultados e performance;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e alto nível de precisão;
  • Habilidade para lidar com múltiplas demandas simultaneamente, mantendo organização e clareza.
  • Capacidade de síntese e priorização de informações;
  • Proatividade e autonomia;


O que oferecemos:

  • Treinamento técnico e desenvolvimento pessoal;
  • Direcionamento estratégico;
  • Objetividade na cobrança e no feedback;
  • Ambiente de alta autonomia e responsabilidade;
  • Atuação em um time colaborativo;
  • Sinceridade e transparência.


ETAPAS DO PROCESSO SELETIVO

  • Triagem de currículos – Análise de perfil profissional.
  • Contato inicial – Esclarecimento de informações e alinhamento de expectativas.
  • Teste avaliativo – Enviado por e-mail aos candidatos selecionados.
  • Entrevista – Avaliação do RH e diretor da empresa.
  • Feedback e contratação – Formalização da contratação.


Nossa equipe te espera!

title: Designer Gráfico
description:
Sobre a Thome e Santos


Thome e Santos uma empresa especializada na organização de eventos de corrida de rua e esportivos , com atuação consolidada desde 2005 em Curitiba e região . Nascida da paixão pelo esporte da família Thome e Santos, a organização cresceu ao longo de mais de uma década, combinando experiência, dedicação e profissionalismo para promover experiências memoráveis que incentivam a prática esportiva e um estilo de vida saudável e transformador.


Resumo da Posição

Estamos em busca de um Designer Gráfico talentoso e proativo, com um forte senso de urgência e paixão por entregar resultados visuais de alta qualidade em tempo hábil. O profissional ideal será um entusiasta de esportes, demonstrando disciplina e energia, e possuirá conhecimento prático em ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial aplicadas ao design para otimizar processos e elevar a qualidade do trabalho. Este papel é crucial para a execução da nossa estratégia de comunicação visual, trabalhando com uma identidade visual já estabelecida para criar materiais impactantes e eficazes.


Responsabilidades

- Desenvolver e adaptar peças gráficas para diversas plataformas, incluindo banners digitais, postagens para redes sociais, e-mail marketing e materiais informativos, seguindo a identidade visual da empresa.

- Criar e otimizar peças visuais para campanhas de tráfego pago, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos de marketing e alta performance.

- Realizar ajustes e aprimoramentos em apresentações corporativas, assegurando coesão visual e clareza na comunicação.

- Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial para acelerar o processo de criação, gerar variações de design, otimizar imagens e explorar novas possibilidades criativas, sempre mantendo a qualidade e a originalidade.

- Garantir a consistência da marca em todos os materiais produzidos, aplicando rigorosamente as diretrizes de identidade visual.

- Colaborar com a equipe de marketing e outros designers para garantir a entrega de projetos dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


Requisitos

- Formação superior ou técnica em Design Gráfico, Comunicação Visual ou áreas correlatas.

- Portfólio robusto que demonstre habilidade em design digital e impresso, com foco em agilidade e volume de produção.

- Experiência comprovada na criação de materiais para redes sociais, e-mail marketing, banners e tráfego pago.

- Conhecimento e experiência prática com ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial aplicadas ao design (ex: geradores de imagem, otimizadores de layout, ferramentas de automação de design).

- Domínio de softwares de design como Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign.

- Excelente senso estético, atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão com prazos apertados.

- Prática regular de esportes, com forte preferência por corrida de rua, demonstrando disciplina, energia e resiliência. Este é um requisito fundamental, dada a natureza da nossa empresa no segmento esportivo.


Dfierenciais

- Experiência com ferramentas de prototipagem (ex: Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD).

- Conhecimento básico em edição de vídeo ou motion graphics.


Horário de Trabalho

  • De segunda a sexta-feira, das 7:30 às 17:30.

Quais os requisitos?

- Formação em técnico agrícola, engenharia agronômica ou áreas afins;

- Experiência em Tratos Culturais e liderança de pessoas.


Qual localidade?

Guaíra/SP


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

Data Engineering & SQL

Technical Skills

  • Understanding of data warehousing concepts and ETL processes

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with Power BI alongside SSRS
  • Understanding of data modeling (star schema, dimensional modeling)

title: Data & Vendor Bd Manager
description:
About the Role

Bettr is Ant International's Buy Now, Pay Later platform expanding across emerging markets. As Data & Vendor BD Manager , you will own the full lifecycle of data partnerships and vendor relationships that power Bettr's credit decisioning in Brazil, from sourcing and evaluating data providers through to contract negotiation, integration oversight, and ongoing performance management.


Responsibilities:


Data Source Identification & Evaluation

Identify and evaluate third-party data providers relevant to Bettr's BNPL credit operations in Brazil, including credit bureaus, behavioral data sources, and alternative data providers. Assess data quality, coverage, pricing, and compliance suitability to support Bettr's underwriting and risk models.


Vendor Onboarding & Integration

Lead the end-to-end onboarding process for new data and technology vendors. Work closely with internal product, risk, and technology teams to ensure seamless API integration, data ingestion, and operational readiness. Manage onboarding timelines and hold vendors accountable to agreed delivery milestones.


Vendor Relationship Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for key vendors and credit bureau partners. Conduct regular business reviews, manage contract renewals, negotiate commercial terms, and resolve operational issues promptly to ensure continuity and quality of service.


Market & Regulatory Intelligence

Maintain a comprehensive understanding of Brazil's data and financial infrastructure landscape, including BCB regulations, LGPD, SCR requirements, and open finance developments. Proactively identify new data sources and vendor opportunities that can improve Bettr's credit decisioning and risk management capabilities.


Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with risk, product, legal, and technology teams to translate business requirements into vendor specifications, data procurement decisions, and integration priorities. Act as the bridge between Bettr's commercial needs and its technical and regulatory infrastructure.


Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in vendor management, BD, or data partnerships within the Brazilian fintech, payments, or consumer credit industry.
  • Familiarity with Brazil's credit bureau ecosystem and financial infrastructure providers.
  • Understanding of Brazilian financial regulations including BCB guidelines, LGPD, and SCR data requirements.
  • Strong commercial negotiation skills with a track record of managing vendor contracts and SLAs.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with technical, risk, and legal teams in a fast-paced, international environment.
  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese;
    Mandarin is a strong plus.

title: Api Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. We are looking for API Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer API standards and architectural guidelines.


Responsibilities

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Sodexo's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool
  • Experience on Azure, Phyton and API development lifecycle.

title: Consultor(A) Wms Manhattan
description:
Sobre a NCS Partners

A NCS Partners é líder em serviços profissionais de supply chain e parceira Platinum de consultoria da Manhattan Associates. Fundada em 2011 por uma equipe de liderança com mais de 25 anos de experiência com a Manhattan Associates, a NCSP cresceu para uma empresa global entregando resultados transformadores nas principais plataformas Manhattan — iSeries, Open Systems e Manhattan Active. construímos parcerias de longo prazo que abrangem Estratégia, Design, Testes, Implementação e Suporte contínuo.

- Familiaridade com banco de dados (DB2, Oracle SQL, PL/SQL) para consultas e troubleshooting básico.

- Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal em português e inglês.

- Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipes multifuncionais e multiculturais.

- Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais conforme necessidade dos projetos.


Diferenciais

- Experiência com implementações de Manhattan Active® Warehouse Management.

- Conhecimento de plataformas enterprise (servidores UNIX/Linux, bancos de dados Oracle).

- Proficiência em Oracle SQL e PL/SQL para desenvolvimento ou troubleshooting.

- Conhecimento em plataformas de API (POSTMAN e similares).

- Experiência com tecnologias de integração (APIs, EDI, middleware). Incluindo o uso de POSTMAN ou similar.

- Familiaridade com módulos Manhattan como Labor Management, Slotting ou Supply Chain Planning.

- Experiência prévia em consultoria em empresas de serviços profissionais.

- Experiência em implementações na América Latina.


O Que Oferecemos

- Oportunidade de trabalhar com uma equipe de classe mundial de especialistas em Manhattan Associates.

- Crescimento profissional e aprendizado contínuo por meio de projetos diversos e desafiadores

title: Business Development Manager - Ress
description:
About our company


Power a New World


OUR VISION


The world is at the intersection of major paradigm shifts toward renewable energy, electrification, and new energy. ‘Power a New World’ is a call to the future amid these changes.


EcoFlow believes in an aspirational, eco-friendly, and technologically driven future that every individual can own. EcoFlow’s meaningfully innovative power solutions are designed to bring a positive impact on individuals, families and society at large.


OUR MISSION


To lead as a reliable and trusted energy companion for families and individuals around the world.

We aim to empower our users with meaningful innovation, helping people across the world to live, dream, and explore without limits.


How It All Started


In 2017, a multidisciplinary team of engineers, with vast experience and expertise in the battery industry, formed EcoFlow. United in the belief that access to power is a fundamental human right, the group began developing solutions to relieve global populations from power insecurity. Today, as an eco-friendly energy solutions company, EcoFlow leads the way with industry- defining portable power stations, solar technology, the world’s first portable home battery with an expandable ecosystem and various smart devices.



Who are we?

We are a young, aspirational and diversified team with a global vision. We aim to empower EFers at the outset, to empower our users through our innovative products and services, and to eventually empower the whole ecosystem and the world. Embracing these ideals, we believe the possibilities of the future are endless as we move, promote, and evolve. We will work with a devoted, open, passionate, and brave mindset to create innovative and reliable products and services driven by clean energy. We do this in an effort to transcend limitations and explore the infinite possibilities in life for millions of families across the world, which will ultimately facilitate the fulfillment of our ecological responsibilities and commitment to the world’s sustainability. Each and every EFer's skills can be honed to perfection in the ocean of diversified opportunities and challenges in this process.


We welcome and appreciate all EFers who are ambitious, pragmatic, and bold to deliver our goals as a team. Together, Let's Power a New World！



Your journey ahead:

When joining us, we expect you to shape our Brazil sales strategy together with the global sales strategy as well as bringing them to life. You will be responsible for exponential growth with our multiple strategic key accounts/ partners in Latin America. You will be working closely with the Latin America regional team as well as our global sales team.



Your Challenges:


1. Develop and expand local distributors, retailers, installers and channel partners in the Brazilian home energy storage market, and establish a sound channel layout and long-term partner relationships.

2. Manage daily channel operations, ensure market compliance, control regional pricing and prevent cross-region sales or price disruption, to achieve assigned sales and revenue targets.

3. Drive product and brand localization in Brazil, plan and execute local marketing activities, promotions and brand campaigns to enhance market penetration and awareness.

4. Conduct competitive intelligence and market analysis, understand local energy policies, consumer demand and industry operation models, and formulate feasible market development strategies and action plans.

5. Work closely with global and regional teams to deliver frontline market insights, customer feedback and competitive dynamics, supporting product and strategy decisions.



Your profile includes:


1. Bachelor’s degree or above. 5+ years of BDM or sales experience in energy storage, solar, power supply or related industries.

2. Proven track record in developing and managing distributors, installers and channel partners.

3. Familiar with Brazilian market and channel norms. Strong business development and negotiation skills.

4. Result-oriented with excellent communication and team collaboration abilities.

5. English proficiency required.

6. Business travel is required.

per policy.

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) and 3+ years in software engineering or production support.

Proficient in Java or a similar language;
strong debugging skillsand ability to write scripts for diagnostics and updates.

Familiarity with Linux and bash.

Clear, empathetic communicator capable of translating complex technical issues for diverse audiences.

Demonstrated bias for action: resolve incidents while building long-term fixes and automations.

Strong problem-solving: identify edge cases, add validations, and anticipate failure modes.

Experience with SDLC and support tooling: GitLab, incident management, JIRA, and standard ticket triage/prioritization.

Preferred qualifications:

Experience supporting trading systems or desks at a large investment bank.

SQL proficiency for rapid data validation and incident triage.

title: Senior International Procurement, Transportantion And Logistics Analyst - English 90%
description:
About the job


The Senior Analyst, International Logistics, serves as a key strategic partner within the Raw Materials Procurement organization, responsible for ensuring the efficient, cost‑effective, and resilient movement of raw materials across the global supply chain. This role combines advanced data analytics with deep logistics expertise to design, optimize, and manage international transportation flows that support production, reduce total landed cost, and strengthen supplier and carrier performance. Serving as a boots‑on‑the‑ground contact, the Senior Analyst drives communication, negotiation, and alignment with both suppliers and transportation providers to ensure operational execution, strategic development and continuous improvement. The Senior Analyst maintains accurate inventory positions through accurate reporting of materials in the supply chain, identifies network inefficiencies, and develops improvement initiatives that enhance service, reduce risk, and support long‑term supply chain competitiveness. Through proactive analysis, cross‑functional collaboration, and continuous process optimization, this position ensures that the company’s global logistics operations are predictable, transparent, and aligned with broader supply chain and business


Scope. Santa Catarina Brazil


objectives


  • Support the efficient and cost‑effective movement of international raw materials by providing accurate data analysis, shipment visibility, and operational coordination.
  • Act as a connector between procurement, logistics, and supplier/carrier partners by translating operational realities and commercial priorities into clear insights and actions.
  • Identify issues and trends, and recommend opportunities for improvement across the international logistics network to strengthen service performance and reduce total landed cost.



What do you need?


To live in Santa Catarina mandatory English 90%

Educational Background: Bachelor of Science in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field, or

equivalent experience.

- Professional Experience: A minimum of 5 years in transportation, international logistics, or

supply chain analytics, with a proven track record of success.

- Detailed knowledge of the North American transportation industry, including LTL, truckload, rail,

warehousing, cross-border, and airfreight

- Knowledge of standard transportation import and export procedures and USDOT requirements

- Advanced experience with transportation pricing methods and practices, customs entry

processes and brokerage/clearance requirements preferred

- Demonstrated experience negotiating commercial terms for both master transportation

agreements and ad hoc projects with carriers, brokers, customs brokers, and rail lines.

- Fundamental understanding of CHEP global operations and business segments preferred

- Thorough understanding of the CHEP network pallet flows and seasonality preferred

Skills and Knowledge - Business Acumen and Problem Solving: Apply knowledge of business rules and processes to

manage organizational tasks efficiently. Utilize strong time management and problem-solving

skills to address challenges effectively



Key Responsibilities May Include:


  • Build and maintain strong relationships with domestic and international carriers, freight forwarders, and suppliers to support reliable and cost‑effective logistics operations.
  • Recommend optimal Incoterms and transportation strategies by assessing risk, cost, and supplier capabilities.
  • Monitor international shipments to maintain accurate daily visibility, escalating delays and risks and supporting timely resolution with carriers, suppliers, and internal teams.
  • Analyze logistics and inventory flow data to identify variances, inefficiencies, and potential cost‑saving or performance‑enhancing opportunities.
  • Prepare regular reporting and dashboards covering shipment status, carrier performance, costs, and inventory impacts to support decision‑making across procurement and operations.
  • Support contract and carrier management activities by gathering performance data, documenting service issues, and contributing to review discussions.
  • Maintain routing guidelines, documentation, and SOPs, helping ensure consistency and accuracy in transportation execution and compliance.
  • Assist with root‑cause investigations into service failures or cost issues, coordinating inputs across carriers, suppliers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with planning, sourcing, operations, and transportation teams to ensure alignment on inbound flows, priorities, and risk areas.

title: Regional Commercial Director
description:
Sobre a Blankstate

A Blankstate é uma empresa de infraestrutura de IA com sede em Londres que foi pioneira em uma nova topologia de modelo para medir interações de forma independente. Em vez de depender de suposições probabilísticas, nossa arquitetura utiliza uma abordagem inspirada na física para decompor as dinâmicas em medições determinísticas de como elas se desenrolam. Estamos construindo uma camada soberana glass-box (caixa de vidro), onde cada conclusão pode ser rastreada diretamente até evidências reprodutíveis. Como cientistas da interação, fornecemos um padrão universal que garante que as ferramentas usadas para avaliar o desempenho permaneçam inteiramente independentes dos modelos que geram o conteúdo.


O Papel

Estamos à procura de um Diretor Comercial Regional (LatAm ) experiente para assumir a responsabilidade final pelo nosso pipeline de receita e velocidade comercial na América Latina. Atualmente, nossa presença regional garantiu fortes relacionamentos institucionais e um ótimo acesso ao mercado. Agora, precisamos de um "closer" (fechador de negócios) dedicado. Você pegará o bastão nas introduções quentes, conduzirá o ciclo de vendas completo de forma independente e escalará nossa estratégia de go-to-market em todo o continente. Você não fará isso sozinho. Trabalhará em uma tríade estratégica: em estreita parceria com as pessoas que continuarão liderando a construção de relacionamentos estratégicos e a abertura de portas, com o suporte de uma equipe dedicada de Operações e Administração para a execução do dia a dia, e com a nossa equipe Global principal, atualmente sediada em Londres.


O Que Você Fará

  • Fechar Contratos Enterprise Diretos : Assumir a propriedade direta de contas enterprise grandes e complexas, desde a qualificação até a assinatura. Você será o principal motor comercial, reduzindo significativamente a dependência do suporte executivo do Reino Unido.
  • Construir o Ecossistema de Parceiros para Escala : Identificar, integrar e escalar uma rede de parceiros de distribuição e parceiros estratégicos de alto desempenho para impulsionar o volume regional e a adoção em massa.
  • Estratégia Comercial : Desenhar as cartilhas de precificação, negociação e contratação na América Latina, adaptadas tanto para engajamentos diretos com clientes quanto para canais de parceiros, com base na prática da matriz (HQ) adaptada ao mercado local.
  • Impulsionar a Adoção : Acelerar a integração da arquitetura da Blankstate nos mercados brasileiro e latino-americano em geral.
  • Apoiar o Lançamento no Mercado de Massa : Colaborar com nosso Chief Marketing Office para apoiar o próximo avanço voltado ao mercado de massa, garantindo que os esforços de vendas regionais estejam alinhados e capitalizem nossa crescente visibilidade global.


Quem Você Pode Ser

  • Um "closer" comprovado com histórico de vendas de sistemas Enterprise B2B complexos, infraestrutura ou soluções de dados/tecnologia.
  • Altamente comercial e autônomo, você sabe como navegar por compras, jurídico e executivos C-level na América Latina.
  • Experiente na construção de movimentos corporativos diretos e canais indiretos de parceiros.
  • Fluente em Português e Inglês (Espanhol é um forte diferencial).


O Que Oferecemos

  • Salário base de R$ 300.000 a R$ 550.000 anuais (dependendo da experiência).
  • Estruturas de comissões agressivas.
  • Um caminho claro para a liderança executiva com vesting de ações (share pool) em uma startup de deeptech do Reino Unido em rápido crescimento.



- EN -

About Blankstate

Blankstate is a London-based AI infrastructure company that pioneered a new model topology to independently measure interactions. Instead of relying on probabilistic guesses, our architecture uses a physics-inspired approach to decompose dynamics into deterministic measurements of how it unfolds. We are building a sovereign, "glass-box" layer where every conclusion traces directly back to reproducible evidence. As scientists of interaction, we provide a universal standard ensuring the tools used to evaluate performance remain entirely independent from the models generating the content.


The Role

We are looking for an experienced Regional Commercial Director (LatAm) to take ultimate ownership of our revenue pipeline and commercial velocity in Latin America.

Currently, our regional presence has secured strong institutional relationships and great market access. We now need a dedicated closer. You will take the baton on warm introductions, drive the full sales cycle independently, and scale our go-to-market strategy across the continent.

You won't be doing this alone. You will operate in a strategic triad: partnering closely with people that will continue to lead strategic relationship building and door-opening, supported by a dedicated Ops & Admin for day-to-day execution and our core Global team currently HQed in London.


What You Will Do

  • Close Direct Enterprise Deals: Take direct ownership of large, complex enterprise accounts from qualification to signature. You will be the primary commercial driver, significantly reducing reliance on UK-based executive support.
  • Build the Partner Ecosystem for Scale: Identify, onboard, and scale a network of high-performing distribution partners and strategic partners to drive regional volume and widespread adoption.
  • Commercial Strategy: Design the LatAm pricing, negotiation, and contracting playbooks tailored for both direct client engagements and partner channels based on the HQ practice adapted to local market.
  • Drive Adoption: Accelerate the integration of Blankstate’s architecture across Brazilian and broader LatAm markets.
  • Support Mass Market Rollout: Collaborate with our Chief Marketing Office to support the upcoming mass-market push, ensuring regional sales efforts align with and capitalize on our expanding global visibility.


Who You Might Be

  • A proven closer with a track record of selling complex B2B Enterprise system, infrastructure, or data/tech solutions.
  • Highly commercial and autonomous, you know how to navigate procurement, legal, and C-level stakeholders in LatAm.
  • Experienced in building both direct enterprise motions and indirect partner channels.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a strong plus).


What We Offer

  • R$ 300,000 - R$ 550,000 base salary annually (dependent on experience).
  • Aggressive commission structures.
  • A clear pathway to executive leadership with share pool vesting in a fast-growing UK-based deeptech startup.

title: Terapeuta Ocupacional
description:
O(A) Terapeuta ocupacional da Clínica Hope será responsável pela avaliação, produção de relatórios, construção do PTS, atendimento, evolução diária, orientação parental, construção de materiais complementares se necessário, reavaliação, relatórios complementares, realizar supervisões, receber supervisões e participar de reuniões de equipe.

Suporte ao marketing digital.


ANAMNESE + AVALIAÇÃO COMPLETA

1. A anamnese pode ocorrer de forma remota ou presencial apontando as principais demandas da criança.

2. Utilização de protocolos e escalas necessárias para avaliação completa do paciente.

3. Utilizar o prazo necessário para avaliação da criança, contanto que tenha a devida previsibilidade e ciência da família.

4. Importante sempre dar um feedback para a família ao final de cada sessão avaliativa, para contextualizar aquilo que está sendo observado.

5. De 4 em 4 meses deve-se observar o caso, de acordo com o PTS, apontando a necessidade ou não de reavaliação. Quando necessário, realizar a reavalição completa com protocolos e escalas adequadas.

RELATÓRIOS DEVOLUTIVAS E EVOLUÇÕES

1. O relatório avaliativo é o primeiro a ser produzido, contendo todos os dados coletados, gráficos e tabelas necessárias para compreensão da família. Esse material tem como intuito justificar ou não a necessidade de intervenção e apresentar a frequência sugerida para os atendimentos.

2. Para a apresentação do relatório é agendada uma sessão de devolutiva, cujo o profissional deve apresentar um documento para assinatura dos responsáveis, comprovando que receberam as informações.

3. De 4 em 4 meses, quando for necessária a reavaliação da criança, deve ser realizado um relatório completo com o comparativo dos dados apresentados anteriormente, tabelas e gráficos adequados.

4. Produzir relatório a cada 1 ano, justificando necessidade ou não de continuidade na intervenção, apresentando o trabalho realizado com o paciente, evolução apresentada e informações adicionais a depender do caso.

5. Evoluções devem ocorrer diariamente, relatando o estado geral do paciente, mostrando o que foi trabalhado com a criança e respostas apresentadas aos estímulos oferecidos. Caso tenham recomendações para casa ou atividades complementares também devem ser anexadas aqui. Podem utilizar fotos e vídeos para registros.


PLANEJAMENTO TERAPÊUTICO SINGULAR (PTS) + ORIENTAÇÃO PARENTAL

  1. Elaboração do PTS, respeitando os achados clínicos do processo avaliação, construído, etapa por etapa, de forma individualizada por paciente.
  2. Construção em curto, médio e longo prazo, respeitando o processo do desenvolvimento infantil e necessidades particulares da criança.
  3. Atualização de 4 em 4 meses das habilidades especificadas, contribuindo para uma manutenção efetiva da intervenção do paciente.
  4. Embasamento científico, respaldando-se com os artigos mais atualizados das práticas clínicas referentes à área de atuação.
  5. Atividades complementares, materiais educativos ou materiais auxiliares para orientação e direcionamento parental.
  6. Sempre que tivermos férias coletivas serão oferecidas, previamente, atividades direcionadas, para cada criança e família.
  7. Devolutivas assertivas ao final da sessão com feedback de produtividade da terapia, de forma coesa e específica.


TRABALHO EM EQUIPE TRANSDISCIPLINAR + SUPERVISÕES

  1. É necessário que haja assiduidade quanto aos envolvimentos de outros profissionais durante o processo de intervenção, a garantir que o paciente esteja recebendo estimulações coerentes tendo em vista o desenvolvimento global.
  2. Estar de acordo com as sessões de supervisão clínica estabelecidas pela empresa a fim de garantir a qualidade do tratamento dos pacientes.
  3. Estar de acordo com supervisões externas estabelecidas pela clínica para aprimoramento das técnicas bem como a extensão do conhecimento para área de atuação em transtornos do neurodesenvolvimento.
  4. Manter a sala de atendimento organizada e adequada para cada sessão.
  5. Zelar pelos materiais terapêuticos e equipamentos da clínica.


MARKETING DIGITAL

  1. Sempre que solicitado pela equipe de marketing deverá produzir texto, produzir conteúdo e realizar aprovações de publicações referentes à sua área de atuação.

title: Area Sales Manager (Santa Catarina State)
description:
Ecorobotix SA. creates innovative robotic solutions that reduce the negative ecological impact of modern agriculture. We have developed an AI-based ultra-high precision spot spraying technology that drastically reduces the amount of chemicals used in crop fields while keeping costs competitive. The technology is currently deployed on our tractor towed ARA machine. By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.


To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Santa Catarina State for an:


Area Sales Manager


General objective of the role

As an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company’s agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.


Reporting lines and interactions

This role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA’s.


A day in the life of an Area Sales Manager

The Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.


You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer’s specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment;
you're helping solve problems.


“You’re part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You’re a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.
  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.
  • Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.
  • Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.
  • Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.
  • Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.


Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil.

Must-Have

  • Experience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.
  • Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.


Your Assets

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.
  • Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.
  • High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.
  • Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.
  • Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools.
  • Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills
  • Team-player
